did.description: The DID of the person who registered the book. Included here, so it's verifiable with the bookSig.

bookId.description: The book's ID (as defined on its QR Code)

authors.description: Authors of this book, in order of credit. An empty array implies a book of anonymous or unknown authorship.

bookPub.description: The MultiFormat public key of the book.

bookSig.description: The MultiFormat signature of this record, without this attribute, as created by the private key associated with the book.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the cover image

publicationId.description: The book's Open Library Edition ID

main.description: A book that has been registered on PassingReads
